scope: Diagnostic profile of the existing WSSMux resource fixture, including both engines, echo backend and load generator. This is PR #69 source, not a base/head comparison of PR #67.
result: TestWSMuxResourceProfile passed, including payload verification; no cipher policy or host feature flags were changed.
limitations: This single-host diagnostic is not a maximum-throughput benchmark or a performance comparison of the scheduler.
The combined process includes test backend and load-generator CPU/heap/RSS. It is not the cost of one production tunnel endpoint.
The server exposes only one CPU and lacks the listed crypto acceleration features, so this is not representative of an eight-core deployment.
The 4-vCPU host exposes those acceleration features, but its profile binary upload was interrupted before execution. Its partial upload was explicitly removed; no profile result exists for that host.
Feature flags were inspected in a separate read-only SSH command after the profile run.
remote_cleanup: Profile test directory removed; no production services or global kernel settings changed.
